tools.name: booqable_get_company
tools.description: Fetch the Booqable account this token belongs to — name, currency, default timezone, address. A cheap way to confirm the slug and token work. Booqable: GET /api/4/companies/current.

tools.name: booqable_list_orders
tools.description: List rental orders. Filter by free-text search (order number, customer name/email/address, tags, custom fields), status, payment status, customer, or rental-period range. Booqable: GET /api/4/orders.

tools.name: booqable_get_order
tools.description: Fetch one order with its totals, deposit and payment state, sideloading the customer and order lines by default (override with include, e.g. customer,lines,payments,documents,notes). Booqable: GET /api/4/orders/{id}.

tools.name: booqable_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, optionally searched by name/email or filtered by email, tag or archived state. Booqable: GET /api/4/customers.

tools.name: booqable_get_customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer with order count, revenue and balance due, sideloading their properties (addresses, phone, custom fields) by default. Booqable: GET /api/4/customers/{id}.

tools.name: booqable_list_product_groups
tools.description: List product groups — the catalogue entries (name, SKU, product type, tracking type, pricing). A group holds one or more bookable products (variations). Booqable: GET /api/4/product_groups.

tools.name: booqable_list_products
tools.description: List bookable products (the variations inside product groups). Use a product id for availability checks and booking. Booqable: GET /api/4/products.

tools.name: booqable_check_inventory_availability
tools.description: How many units of one or more products can be booked for an exact period at a location. Returns `available` and `plannable` (plannable can exceed available when shortage is allowed). Get location ids from booqable_list_locations. Booqable: GET /api/4/inventory_availabilities.

tools.name: booqable_get_availability_calendar
tools.description: Day-by-day availability for one product over a month: status (available/partial/unavailable) and bookable quantity per day. Booqable: GET /api/4/availabilities with subject_type=item.

tools.name: booqable_list_plannings
tools.description: List plannings — which product is booked on which order, how many, when, and how many are started (out) or stopped (returned). Filter by order, product, or reservation window. Booqable: GET /api/4/plannings.

tools.name: booqable_list_documents
tools.description: List invoices, quotes and contracts, with totals and payment status. Filter by type, order, customer or status. Booqable: GET /api/4/documents.

tools.name: booqable_list_payments
tools.description: List payments (charges, authorizations and refunds) with amount, deposit, currency, provider and status. Filter by order, customer or payment type. Read only — this server never moves money. Booqable: GET /api/4/payments.

tools.name: booqable_list_locations
tools.description: List pickup/return locations (warehouses, stores) with address and pickup/delivery capability. Location ids are needed for availability checks and orders. Booqable: GET /api/4/locations.

tools.name: booqable_list_notes
tools.description: List internal notes attached to a customer, order, product or other record. Booqable: GET /api/4/notes.

tools.name: booqable_create_customer
tools.description: Create a new customer. Booqable: POST /api/4/customers.

tools.name: booqable_update_customer
tools.description: Update a customer's name, email, legal type, tags, default discount or marketing consent. Only the fields you pass change. Booqable: PUT /api/4/customers/{id}.

tools.name: booqable_create_order
tools.description: Create an EMPTY order for a rental period (status new or draft). Then add products with booqable_book_product and reserve it with booqable_transition_order_status. Locations default to the first active location. Booqable: POST /api/4/orders.

tools.name: booqable_update_order
tools.description: Change an order's rental period, customer, locations or tags. Moving dates can cause a shortage: the call then fails with the shortage details, and a shortage *warning* can be accepted by retrying with confirm_shortage: true. Booqable: PUT /api/4/orders/{id}.

tools.name: booqable_book_product
tools.description: Add a quantity of a product to an order, allocating inventory (creates a planning and a line). By default adds to an existing planning for the same product if there is one. Booqable: POST /api/4/order_fulfillments with a book_product action.

tools.name: booqable_transition_order_status
tools.description: Move an order between statuses: new→draft, draft→reserved (reserves the items and assigns an order number), stopped→archived, or back to an earlier status with revert: true. Canceling is deliberately NOT offered (Booqable cannot un-cancel). started/stopped are reached by picking up/returning items,

tools.name: booqable_create_note
tools.description: Attach an internal note to a customer, order, product or other record. Booqable: POST /api/4/notes.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "booqable_list_payments" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List payments (charges, authorizations and refunds) with amount, deposit, currency, provider and status. Filter by order, customer or payment type. Read only — …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: booqable_list_orders, booqable_list_customers · Private data: booqable_get_company, booqable_get_order, booqable_list_documents, booqable_list_notes, booqable_create_note · Public sink: booqable_list_orders, booqable_list_customers, booqable_create_customer, booqable_update_customer, booqable_create_order, booqable_book_product, booqable_transition_order_status, booqable_create_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: booqable_list_orders, booqable_list_customers · Private data: booqable_get_company, booqable_get_order, booqable_list_documents, booqable_list_notes, booqable_create_note · Public sink: booqable_list_orders, booqable_list_customers, booqable_create_customer, booqable_update_customer, booqable_create_order, booqable_book_product, booqable_transition_order_status, booqable_create_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
